usedFor: Seven Time holds tracked work and Todoist holds personal task lists, so “New Task” becomes a task through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Seven Time, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Every task created in Seven Time appears in Todoist with its title and details.

watchOut: “New Task” in Seven Time is polling, so the Todoist task shows up after a scheduled check.
